positions.title: Forklift Operator
positions.description:
Operated Order Picker to transport a variety of consumer goods and materials between loading, unloading processing and storage areas.

- Operated cherry picker and pallet jack
- Ensured organization and security of all materials in storage area
- Maintained forklift equipment to ensure proper functioning of the equipment
- Assisted in loading and unloading on platforms and and lifting devices
- Completed forklift operator training annually, provided by company
- Operated software along with scan gun for put aways and organization

projects.title: African Marketplace
projects.description:
- Built a website platform that enabled small business owners to set pricing in multiple categories using React

- Wrote code on the backend which allowed the accessibility to list product details, sell, and update features improving functionality

projects.title: Anywhere Fitness
projects.description:
- Designed a fitness class website platform to enable sign ups as an instructor or user to authenticate, and utilized CRUD operations to  create, update and delete classes

- Designed a website function to allow users to create an account and authenticated user access the ability to reschedule or cancel reservations through the mobile app

- Developed search functionality that enabled users to search for classes by certain criteria
